desc: Ideation: establish that all 1->0 flips precede all 0->1 flips (exchange argument), giving cost = sum over steps of current total weight.
Prove optimal optional (1,1) selection is a prefix in descending C (swap argument yielding delta < 0).
Derive and implement cost(0) formula for F/T with pair sums (PFF/PTT) and CT terms.
Implement per-prefix marginal delta formula using sorted F, T, M with prefix sums and bisect; take min over all prefix sizes.
Test implementation on sample 1 (16), sample 2 (0), sample 3 (2867); O(N log N) and 64-bit-safe arithmetic confirmed.
Validate sample tests all pass (SAMPLE TESTS: PASSED all 3 public samples).
